schema.text: Do you need a seat at the stop or on board, and often find none?

en.#Do you need a seat at the stop or on bo: Do you need a seat at the stop or on board, and often find none?

it.#Do you need a seat at the stop or on bo: Hai bisogno di sederti alla fermata o a bordo e spesso non trovi posto?

fr.#Do you need a seat at the stop or on bo: Avez-vous besoin d’une place assise à l’arrêt ou à bord, sans souvent en trouver ?

de.#Do you need a seat at the stop or on bo: Brauchen Sie an der Haltestelle oder im Fahrzeug einen Sitzplatz und finden oft keinen?

tr.#Do you need a seat at the stop or on bo: Durakta veya araçta oturacak yere ihtiyaç duyuyor ama çoğunlukla bulamıyor musunuz?

fa.#Do you need a seat at the stop or on bo: آیا در ایستگاه یا داخل وسیله به صندلی نیاز دارید و اغلب جایی پیدا نمی‌کنید؟

hu.#Do you need a seat at the stop or on bo: Szüksége van ülőhelyre a megállóban vagy a járművön, és gyakran nem talál?

ar.#Do you need a seat at the stop or on bo: هل يلزمك مقعد في المحطة أو داخل المركبة، وغالبًا لا يتوفر؟
